reviews.reason: Repeated test sends require a separate delivery purpose and normal-only uniqueness; older fanout workers use the old conflict target.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop all older API and worker processes, apply the migration and role grants, and start only matching binaries. See docs/events.md#upgrade-and-rollback.

reviews.reason: Collection-owned sinks and explicit grants change subscription and dispatch authorization; older writers and workers do not enforce that boundary.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop all older API and worker processes, apply the migration and role grants, and restart matching binaries. Bind existing credential-bearing webhooks to their destinations. See docs/events.md#upgrade-and-rollback.

reviews.reason: Older API and worker replicas do not enforce interactive credential kinds, family revocation, and refresh rotation. The authentication contract requires a coordinated upgrade.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop older API and worker replicas, apply the session/activity migration and role grants, then start matching binaries and upgrade frontend/SDK consumers. Clear existing BFF sessions and sign in again. See docs/auth_model.md#interactive-sessions.

reviews.reason: The migration inserts runtime policy groups that older API and worker binaries cannot deserialize, even before an administrator edits a policy.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop all older API and worker replicas, back up the database, apply the migration, then start upgraded binaries everywhere. Restore the pre-upgrade database snapshot before reverting to older binaries. See docs/runtime_settings.md#upgrade-and-rollback.

reviews.reason: Older replicas bypass candidate verification and cannot read browser provider definitions or runtime Treetop profiles. Security activation must use matching binaries everywhere.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop all API and worker replicas and back up the database. Apply migrations and role grants, upgrade administrator clients to the candidate workflow, then start matching binaries everywhere. Configure explicit private authentication egress where required. See docs/security_candidates.md#upgrade-and-recovery.

reviews.reason: Older replicas do not clear durable authentication interactions during security recovery or logical restore. Interaction authority and issuance require matching binaries everywhere.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop all API and worker replicas, back up the database, apply migrations and role grants, then restart matching binaries. Restore the pre-upgrade snapshot before downgrading. External Rust adapters must implement the SDK 0.9 interaction contract. See docs/authentication_interactions.md#upgrade-and-recovery.
